sources.snippet: English · 简体中文 · 日本語 OneJev is a multimodal System One decision model. It returns calibrated probabilities for typed questions about screenshots, photos, videos and text in a single forward pass. Available in 0.8B, 4B, 9B and 27B.

sources.title: OneJev - omnijev.github.io
sources.snippet: OneJev is a multimodal System One decision model. Screenshots, photos and video go in with typed questions; calibrated probabilities come out in one forward pass, behind TypeSafe's System One API.
